query:
UPDATE "Message" AS m
            SET "isRead" = true
            FROM (
                SELECT 
                    unnest($1::integer[]) AS c_id,
                    unnest($2::integer[]) AS u_id,
                    unnest($3::bigint[]) AS read_ts
            ) AS data
            WHERE m."conversationId" = data.c_id 
              AND m."senderId" != data.u_id    
              AND m."isRead" = false           
              AND m."createdAt" <= data.read_ts
